newsitem.title: JAPAN: US Treasuries rise in Tokyo on post-G7 dlr gains.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries rise in Tokyo on post-G7 dlr gains.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were well-supported at midday Monday in Tokyo, buoyed by the dollar's strength after Sunday's Group of Seven (G7) meeting.

"The G7 meeting had no direct impact on the Treasury market, but the market benefited from the dollar's rise," a trader said. "Basically, the market will be examining the trend of the economy through a series of economic data this week."

Traders were particularly looking towards the first quarter U.S. Employment Cost Index due on Tuesday. In a Reuters poll, economists' average forecast called for a 0.9 percent rise in the ECI versus a 0.8 percent gain in the prior quarter.
